basic_details.job_title: Pondicherry University Research Associate (Coastal Disaster Management) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Coastal Disaster Management, Pondicherry University, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) Campus, is filling one Research Associate (RA) post on a CSIR-funded project under the CSIR-EMR-II scheme. The consolidated pay is Rs. 58,000 per month plus applicable HRA, and the essential qualification is a Doctorate (PhD) in Hydrogeology/Hydrology/Water Resource Management or a relevant subject. Applications go by email to [email protected] within 21 days from the date of the advertisement, 23 November 2026, which is about 14 December 2026.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 21 days from the date of advertisement, about 14 December 2026

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backwards Classes (OBC), women, and persons with Disabilities (PwD), as per applicable rules. The notice does not print a date for counting age.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application for the Research Associate (RA) post under the advertisement number PU/R&DC-2/CSIR/PT/DCDM/2026-2027/411.
Address it to Dr. P. Thambidurai, Department of Coastal Disaster Management, Pondicherry University, Sri Vijaya Puram Campus.
Send it by email to [email protected] within 21 days from the date of the advertisement, 23 November 2026.
For queries, the notice gives the mobile number +91-9930566995.
The notice does not give an application format or a list of documents to attach with the email. It does not give an email subject line either.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary and contractual, and the engagement is for an initial period of one year. Extension for the second year depends on satisfactory and successful annual evaluation. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated for the online interview. Original documents must be produced for verification during the selection process, if required.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate (RA) posts are advertised by Pondicherry University?
faq.answer: One post. The notice prints the number of vacancies as 1 (One) for the Research Associate (RA) post in the Department of Coastal Disaster Management.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Pondicherry University Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice asks candidates to apply within 21 days from the date of the advertisement, 23 November 2026. That is about 14 December 2026. The notice prints no calendar date for the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Doctorate (PhD) in Hydrogeology/Hydrology/Water Resource Management or a relevant subject. Relevant research experience in Groundwater Modelling, Resistivity Survey, and Programming Skills with GIS & remote sensing will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 years. The upper limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, women and PwD candidates, as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Research Associate (RA)?
faq.answer: The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 58,000 per month, plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per CSIR norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 58,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the Rs. 58,000 per month is plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per CSIR norms. It does not print the HRA amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Pondicherry University Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Send the application by email to Dr. P. Thambidurai, Department of Coastal Disaster Management, at [email protected]. The notice also gives the mobile number +91-9930566995.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated to attend an online interview. Original documents must be produced for verification during the selection process, if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Research Associate (RA) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls the position purely temporary and contractual. It is for an initial period of one year, extendable for the second year subject to satisfactory and successful annual evaluation.

faq.question: Q10. Which project does the Research Associate (RA) post belong to?
faq.answer: The post belongs to the CSIR-funded project "Integrated Geo-Hydrological Assessment and AI-Based Support for Long-Term Water Security in the South Andaman Island" under the CSIR-EMR-II scheme. The project tenure is 2026-2028.
